records.subject: You're in -- let's get River Works set up
records.body:
Hi Jules,

Welcome! Wrenfield works best once there's a real project in it, so that's the one thing I'd suggest doing first. Inviting your team comes next -- tasks are a lot more useful once more than one person is on them.

Reply any time.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

draft.subject: One next step for River Works
draft.body:
Hi Jules,

Thanks again for making time for our welcome call last week — good to have River Works underway, and nice to see a teammate invited already.

The one thing I'd still suggest starting with is a first project: in Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so everything else gets easier once one exists. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project if that's helpful.

Would a short call this week work to set that up together? Happy to walk through it with you.

Best,
Nadia
